description: "Practical Rules for the Management of a Locomotive Engine" by Charles Hutton Gregory is a technical publication written in the early 19th century. This guide aims to provide practical instructions for the operation and management of locomotive engines, focusing on safety and efficiency during both routine operations and emergency situations.
